html:
Duration: 2H00
Temperature: -15 celsius
Subjects observed: Orion Nebula.
Mount: altAz

In the afternoon, I made myself a Hartmann mask with two circles and a triangle (photo to come) out of a cardboard box lid. Nothing very pretty or precise. My goal is to get a better focus. Here is the result of stacking 7 photos of 60 seconds at ISO 800 with the Canon EOS XTI at the focus of the LX90. Stacking done with DeepSkyStacker using VMware Fusion on Mac OS X 10.5. Better and better. The result is encouraging. Next steps: flat frames and increasing the number of frames to 25-30.
